findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chat_get_doc, chat_join, chat_messages, chat_moderate, chat_participants, chat_save_doc, chat_wait_events, delete_content, upload_file, upload_text · Private data: chat_create, chat_join, chat_messages, chat_moderate, chat_save_doc, chat_send, chat_send_file, chat_wait_events, delete_content, upload_file, upload_text · Public sink: chat_create, chat_messages, chat_moderate, chat_register_llm, chat_save_doc, chat_send, chat_send_file, delete_content, upload_file, upload_text · Destructive: chat_messages, delete_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chat_get_doc, chat_join, chat_messages, chat_moderate, chat_participants, chat_save_doc, chat_wait_events, delete_content, upload_file, upload_text · Private data: chat_create, chat_join, chat_messages, chat_moderate, chat_save_doc, chat_send, chat_send_file, chat_wait_events, delete_content, upload_file, upload_text · Public sink: chat_create, chat_messages, chat_moderate, chat_register_llm, chat_save_doc, chat_send, chat_send_file, delete_content, upload_file, upload_text · Destructive: chat_messages, delete_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
